paragraphs: StarRez sells a configurable platform that student housing providers use to run housing and event management operations. The same system handles conference and event work, including group bookings, lodging, and event logistics.

On the housing side it covers room selection, roommate matching, and meal plans. Students complete applications, pick rooms themselves, sign contracts, and meet other residents in one place. Residence life staff manage conduct, community operations, and student employment through a module called Rez360. Operations teams handle inspections, maintenance, and package tracking on mobile friendly tools.

The company says it partners with more than 1,300 higher education teams. It lists certification for SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS Level 1, and Cyber Essentials Plus, and describes itself as HIPAA-Ready and FERPA-Ready. Private student accommodation operators are a second market, with links to online travel agency channels to fill vacant spaces. Support runs around the clock through a service the company calls StarCare Online.

quote.text: The Unified Platform for Thriving Student Communities
